info.title: Fund Agent
info.description: A production-ready FastAPI template with LangGraph and Langfuse integration

post.description:
Register a new user.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    user_data: User registration data

Returns:
    UserResponse: The created user info

Login a user.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    email: User's email
    password: User's password
    grant_type: Must be "password"

Returns:
    TokenResponse: Access token information

Raises:
    HTTPException: If credentials are invalid

Exchange a refresh token for a new access token (spec 3.1).

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    refresh_token: The refresh token issued at login.

Returns:
    TokenResponse: A fresh access token and a rotated refresh token.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 401 when the refresh token is invalid or revoked.

Revoke the caller's refresh tokens (spec 3.1 用户退出).

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    None: 204 with no body. Access tokens stay valid until they expire.

get.description:
Return the authenticated user's profile (spec 3.1 获取当前用户信息).

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    CurrentUserResponse: Profile without credentials.

patch.description:
Change the signed-in user's display name and/or email (spec 3.1).

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    payload: Fields to change; omitted fields keep their current value.
    user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    CurrentUserResponse: The profile after the update.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 when the new email already belongs to another user.

post.description:
Create a new chat session for the authenticated user.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    user: The authenticated user

Returns:
    SessionResponse: The session ID, name, and access token

patch.description:
Update a session's name.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    session_id: The ID of the session to update
    name: The new name for the session
    current_session: The current session from auth

Returns:
    SessionResponse: The updated session information

delete.description:
Delete a session for the authenticated user.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    session_id: The ID of the session to delete
    current_session: The current session from auth

Returns:
    None

get.description:
Get all session IDs for the authenticated user.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    user: The authenticated user

Returns:
    List[SessionResponse]: List of session IDs

schema.title: Response Get User Sessions Api V1 Auth Sessions Get

post.description:
Process a chat request using LangGraph.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    chat_request: The chat request containing messages.
    session: The current session from the auth token.

Returns:
    ChatResponse: The processed chat response.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If there's an error processing the request.

Process a chat request using LangGraph with streaming response.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    chat_request: The chat request containing messages.
    session: The current session from the auth token.

Returns:
    StreamingResponse: A streaming response of the chat completion.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If there's an error processing the request.

get.description:
Get all messages for a session.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    session: The current session from the auth token.

Returns:
    ChatResponse: All messages in the session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If there's an error retrieving the messages.

delete.description:
Clear all messages for a session.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    session: The current session from the auth token.

Returns:
    dict: A message indicating the chat history was cleared.

List positions with derived metrics; optional account filter.

Price an order on its confirm day and show the resulting holding.

Declared before ``POST /positions/{fund_code}/trades`` in spirit but on a
distinct path, so no literal segment can be swallowed by the fund code.

post.description: Record a purchase or redemption and re-project the holding from the ledger.

get.description: One position; `account_id` narrows it to a single account (spec 9.3).

patch.description:
同步持仓: restate what the holdings screen shows (spec 3.7.1).

Updates require `expected_version`; a stale version returns 409 so a
concurrent screenshot import can never silently overwrite user edits. On a
fund with a trade ledger, 份额/成本/收益 are dropped by the service — only
持有金额 and 首次购买日期 come through this door.

MinuteExternalPoint.title: MinuteExternalPoint
MinuteExternalPoint.description:
One minute of a trading session.

``volume`` and ``amount`` are per-minute, derived from the source's running
totals; ``average_price`` is only meaningful for stocks. ``trade_date`` stays
None for a single session and is filled for the five-day series, where the
points span several days.

PositionUpsertRequest.title: PositionUpsertRequest
PositionUpsertRequest.description:
同步持仓: restate what a holdings screen shows (partial allowed).

持仓成本 and 平均成本净值 are not inputs — both follow from 持有金额 minus
持有收益, and a stored cost would otherwise outrank a profit he restates.
On a fund with a BUY/SELL ledger the service also drops 份额/收益 here,
because those belong to the trade records.

SymbolCompanyResponse.title: SymbolCompanyResponse
SymbolCompanyResponse.description:
GET /markets/{symbol}/company response.

``company`` is None for the indexes and non-A股 listings that have no record
in the source, which the screen renders as a hidden section rather than an
error, so one flaky upstream cannot break the chart above it.

SymbolQuoteResponse.title: SymbolQuoteResponse
SymbolQuoteResponse.description:
GET /markets/{symbol}/quote response.

Inherits the snapshot's fields verbatim. Units follow the house rule:
``change_pct``, ``turnover_rate`` and ``amplitude`` are percent points,
``amount`` is in whole currency units and the two market caps are in 亿.
